technical_decision: SUPPORTED for the explicitly registered current metadata/retained-state profile after J254; no demonstrated applicable implementation residual remains in the audited eight requirements/sixteen class groups. Full gate passed; root actual J254 release/checkbox decision pending.
literal: Добавить read-only doctor для missing/corrupt blobs, dangling refs/work, duplicate application, stale generation, orphaned batch, missing receipt и archive coverage. Ремонт и повтор отправки не выполняются doctor автоматически.

base_matrix.role: complete commands/source/test/ownership/class registry; its pre-J254 OPEN decision and RESIDUAL-1 are superseded only by this post-assessment

requirements.missing_corrupt_retained_bodies: Covered by strict frozen payload/snapshot hashes, shared immutable legacy archive guards, declared native delivery/work/review/accounting models. Strict serialization/ref failures ERROR; unproven legacy/unknown-model data remains unavailable/advisory, not fabricated modern corruption.
requirements.dangling_refs_work: Covered for registered typed known parents/work/current+previous paid-name refs, J251 amendment snapshots/carriers/lineage, source/content metadata and actual continuation parent+listed child Publication IDs. No currentowner equality or arbitrary-JSON traversal claim.
requirements.duplicate_application: Covered by complete actual generation/phase or explicit target namespace/ref key; known invalid null-key rows not duplicates. Distinct keys valid; no duplicate-billing verdict.
requirements.stale_generation: Covered advisory only where current producer defines primary queued/submitting/unconsumed generation. Raw explicit saved generation required; secondary/generationless/historical scopes not invented.
requirements.orphaned_batch: Covered item-parent existence plus all saved batch expected count vs all retained item rows, including consumed/forgotten. Deficit advisory; excess/invalid count error; unavailable schema/count evidence null.
requirements.missing_receipt: Covered exact original(provider,batch,custom), actual item purpose and both-known request SHA for all10purposes. SameSHA/currentconsumer never substitutes. Historical absent receipt advisory/legacySHA unknown.
requirements.archive_coverage: Covered bounded captured extraction/candidate/selection/source graph identity/count/ordinal/bounds/parent checks. Stored prefix/omission/unknown explicit; no complete raw traversal or legal selection quality claim.
requirements.read_only_no_auto_action: Covered immutable read-only checkpointed snapshots, before/after hashes/livejournal guards, separate create-only output. No repair, provider, capture, retry, resend, pipeline or production processing.

class_groups.carrier: status amendments; bills joint/reviews; bills/status supplements
legacy_* tables and admitted projection columns
amendment_input_snapshots; intent/item meta and computation result ref

j254_residual_closure.implementation: continuation_children counts exact listed continuation_ids edge slots; tests physical Publication ID presence from already inventoried rows. Parent uses same observed-ID set, so oversized ints never reach SQLite bind or diagnostics.
j254_residual_closure.schema_control: existing missing-publications case asserts all child counts null/unavailable
j254_residual_closure.namespace: local Publication IDs only; not Telegram message, event or content-version IDs
j254_residual_closure.semantics: availability advisory only; presence does not prove ownership/current content/send/retry eligibility; cleaned/unreadable membership unknown

qualification.peer_review: exact final three-file pins CLEAR; no independent tests/edits/network

root_pinned_observation.prior_retained_fields: root independently exact excluding declared new section/limitation

deferred_or_inherently_unknown.raw_originals: User-deferred raw legislative/archive body store/backends and full raw traversal are N.A. to this current profile, not silently implemented. Retained application bodies remain in scope.
deferred_or_inherently_unknown.legacy: Missing unstamped/cleaned/erased data and unsupported layouts remain explicit unavailable/unknown; no old source events/clocks, paid calls, original questions or provenance fabricated.
deferred_or_inherently_unknown.legal_whole_db: No legal/materiality/source applicability verdict, human gold, every arbitrary JSON key/wholeDB semantic completeness or complete history claim.
deferred_or_inherently_unknown.natural_cycles: Other DA10.7 natural lifecycle acceptance remains a separate requirement, not a reason to redefine this technical doctor requirement.
